items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-07-31
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Madeline; the mention is made by the interviewer ('he and his wife, Madeline') in the context of the interviewer's own observations.

ctx.x: dance with him. I think, uh, he still gets around. He would, at least until recently,

he would get around on the bus, and, and I'd see him everywhere, uh, all over town. He'd meet him at Canal and Carondelet, and, uh, we'd, he and his wife, Madeline, would be on the, uh, bus sometimes. I'd be going to meet someone, and maybe he'd be on the two-lane bus, or something, but, uh, odd way, and he's a very active man, because, especially considering that he's got a pacemaker. Recently, uh, the damn thing stopped, and he almost died. Mm. He, he seems to somehow take very good care of himself. Uh, maybe…
Mortality does sort of seem to be with us from time to time. Yeah. Yeah, well, that's, especially,
